rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something repellently frightening, shocking, or ghastly.

example.english: The corpse scenes in that horror film were truly gruesome.
example.traditional: 嗰套恐怖片入面啲屍體畫面真係恐怖。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2 jap6 min6 di1 si1 tai2 waa2 min2 zan1 hai6 hung2 bou3

rows.note: Use this for an awful or terrible result, performance, or situation when the sense is simply that it is very bad.

example.english: Our team’s performance in the match was gruesome.
example.traditional: 我哋隊今場踢波踢得真係差勁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 gam1 coeng4 tek3 bo1 tek3 dak1 zan1 hai6 caa1 ging6
